parrafo_1.es: MakeOverBeauti.Studio es el estudio de Maria Stefania Lorefice en Deerfield Beach. El equipo, con Maria, Luz y Lud, se especializa en revertir el dano de color y en tratamientos de cuero cabelludo anti-edad.

parrafo_2.es: Luzmila Dahlstrom suma 24 anos de experiencia en dermatologia a los facials, asi que el cuidado de tu piel recibe el mismo nivel de atencion que tu cabello.
parrafo_2.en: Luzmila Dahlstrom brings 24 years of dermatology experience to the facials, so your skin gets the same level of care as your hair.

items.quote: This was by far the BEST experience I have ever had relating to a salon. In regards to the treatment, the pricing, and just flat out overall satisfaction! She is amazing.
I've been to several hairstylists here in South Florida, and I was never fully satisfied with my hair color. On top of that, my hair was breaking a lot. Here it finally got fixed.
I've never dyed my hair before and was super nervous to get highlights done but Mariastefania walked me through the whole process and made me feel super comfortable.
